notes:
## Changes

- Add table-based texture replacer UI and move it onto the same launcher row as audio and mesh replacers
- Add recursive `Import folder...` support to audio, mesh, and texture replacers with automatic row generation by filename
- Improve audio replacer playback, suppression, pooling, preload behavior, and startup bootstrap handling
- Improve mesh replacer startup/bootstrap behavior and queue replacements that appear before assets finish loading
- Fix WinForms clipboard copy crashes when using `Ctrl+C` in replacement grids
- Add reference import archives and hero weapon audio event ID documentation
